entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David, I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I purchased. I've used them a few times, but they're just not working out.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's the fit. They're giving me terrible blisters on my heels after about an hour. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but the shoes themselves are the problem.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Blisters are definitely no fun and can ruin a ride. Let me get your order details to check the return eligibility. Can I have your name and order number?
Certainly. The name is Sarah Chen, and the order number is VF78122.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the cycling shoes. It looks like they were delivered 67 days ago. Let me just check our policy here... yes, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
That's great, thank you. Now, since I did have to deal with the discomfort and the hassle of returning them, would you be able to offer a small credit or a discount code for my next purchase?

I'm glad I could get that return approved for you. Our policy allows for the full refund on the item, which I've initiated, but I'm not authorized to add a promotional discount for a fit-related return. The best I can offer is the full refund for the shoes.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. The full refund is fine. What do I do next?

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives them, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that covers it. Thanks for your help, David.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find you a more comfortable pair of shoes in the future. Have a great day.
